title: RTP FIXED
description: Fast and lightweight random teleport plugin. Multiverse support, configurable, and optimized performance.
body:
# RTP Fixed

A fast and lightweight Random Teleport plugin for Paper, Purpur, and Spigot servers.

RTP Fixed is designed to provide quick RTP without heavy safe-location scanning, server freezes, or lag spikes. Players can use `/rtp` from any world and be teleported to a configurable RTP world with a customizable countdown and cooldown system.

### Features

* Fast random teleportation
* Paper, Purpur & Spigot support
* Minecraft 1.21.1 - 1.21.11
* Multiverse-Core support
* Configurable RTP world
* Countdown & cooldown system
* Movement cancel support
* ActionBar & BossBar countdowns
* Custom messages & sounds
* Admin RTP commands
* Optimized for Chunky pre-generated worlds

### Commands

`/rtp` - Teleport yourself

`/rtp <player>` - Teleport another player

`/rtp reload` - Reload configuration

### Permissions

`prtp.use`

`prtp.admin`

`prtp.cooldown.bypass`
